{"summary":"Customers report duplicate charges, forcing them to cancel payments and then pay again. [#tk_2422998]

Many users complain that their accounts show incorrect balances, with the app displaying lower amounts than the actual balance, leading to confusion and frustration. [#tk_1922662]

Fraudulent charges are a major concern, with some customers alleging over $300 in unauthorized transactions and demanding refunds. [#tk_174194]

Repeated billing errors, such as being charged $80 without prior notice, have caused users to abandon the service entirely. [#tk_494162]

Overall, the negative sentiment highlights a lack of timely support and transparent communication, prompting customers to threaten legal action. [#tk_2500977]"}
